prompt.project_info: Photorealistic 3:4 vertical portrait in an indoor late-night arcade, with studio-grade clarity, visible skin and fabric detail, and a 35mm film-inspired candid documentary aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with softly tousled honey-blonde hair, luminous realistic skin, natural cinematic makeup, subtle freckles, expressive almond-shaped eyes, softly defined lips, and a warm playful smile caught mid-laugh. She is seated sideways on an arcade motorcycle game, one foot on the platform, one hand loosely gripping the handlebar, glancing back over her shoulder with effortless confidence. Do not reproduce Ana de Armas or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Frame a 3:4 vertical candid portrait with the arcade motorcycle cabinet in detailed foreground, glowing interface lights, holographic speed indicators and reflective surfaces. In the background include softly blurred pinball machines, pixelated scoreboards, neon signage and polished floors with deep spatial depth. Dress the adult woman in a muted-red vintage-inspired cropped racer jacket with soft leather texture, visible stitching and slightly rolled sleeves, high-waisted ivory matte leather-look shorts with clean tailoring and natural creases, minimalist silver hoops and a thin chain necklace. No visible branding.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use moody cinematic lighting with deep shadows, neon cyan and crimson rim lights, soft facial fill and subtle reflections for a noir mood. Grade with crimson red, cool cyan blue, soft purple and dark graphite tones. Add slight motion blur only where natural while keeping face and subject readable.
prompt.technical_specs: 8K-style photorealistic detail, 3:4 vertical, 35mm film aesthetic, shallow depth of field, candid documentary framing, realistic neon reflections, sharp fabric grain and skin texture, no readable text, logos or watermark.
